objective: The data investigator (package 18.3): benchmark v2's seeded tables with planted traps (its dev split and two replicas for building, its sealed test split for one run) read by dclab_core.analyse's rules alone, by the rules with the data investigator (column names and kinds, never values; every proposal tested as a telling name is), and by a plain prompted model; scored on planted traps found and clean columns accused. Gate investigator_gate_v1, fixed before the runs: on the sealed split, more traps found and no more false alarms.
rule: Scores say how these readers handle these seeded tables' column names, not any other table, and nothing about production readiness.
